# Pose

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Pose`](gmeow-Pose.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Pose>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A frame-relative position and orientation of an object — a 6-DOF pose. A pose consists of a position (spatial coordinates in a reference frame) and an orientation (quaternion, Euler angles, heading/bearing, or a homogeneous transform matrix). Aligns by reference to IEEE 1872-2015 [pos:QuantitativePose](http://purl.org/ieee1872-owl/pos#QuantitativePose) and structurally to OGC GeoPose 1.0.

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)
